notes:
Short background: Tideway builds in-product search and insight cards for B2B product analytics. Heavy use of embeddings for similarity search and reranking pipelines for candidate prioritization. Initially validated hosted API for quality and streaming. Now moving to Dedicated to control tail latency and reduce per-query cost at higher volume.

POC goals: validate Dedicated pool behavior under real traffic patterns and prove safe rollback paths. Acceptance metrics: 99th latency improvement vs Hosted by at least 20%, embedding vector generation throughput >= 150 vectors/s sustained, rerank latency 95th <= 300ms.

Dedicated POC plan (agreed):
- Duration: phased 72h canary followed by 5-day scaled soak if successful.
- Traffic split: start at 3% production traffic -> monitor 24h -> 15% for next 48h -> expand to 40% only after metric gating.
- Model variants: primary = 6B quantized encoder-decoder for embeddings + cheap rerank head; fallback = 6B fp32 or a tuned 2.7B accuracy-optimized variant.
- Routing & canary mechanics: use route tags (service:search, route:production) in request metadata. Canary router will inject sampling header and send to Dedicated pool in us-central1.
- Fallback behavior: automatic fallback to Hosted API on any of: error rate >0.7% for 5m window, 95th latency breach >2x threshold for 3 consecutive 1-min windows, or evidence of embedding regression on canary eval set. Fallback uses weighted routing to Hosted first, then cross-region to us-east1 as warm standby.
- Rollback runbook: manual and automatic paths. Auto-circuit trips to Hosted; manual rollback requires SE confirmation and will pause canary and trigger post-mortem.

Operational & telemetry requirements raised by Tideway:
- Traces: per-request tracing IDs (trace_id header) to tie Redwood spans into their Jaeger stack.
- Metrics: per-model p95/p99, cold-start counts, KV cache hit-rate, quantize-mode telemetry.
- Logs: audit events for model version selection and key rotation; weekly export to their S3 bucket.
- KMS: customer-managed key (Cloud HSM) preferred for embeddings at rest.

Pricing/contract notes:
- Procurement pushing for 12-month committed throughput with quarterly true-ups; wants GPU unit price floor for term.
- Interested in a blended price showing quantized Dedicated vs Hosted per-100k query TCO. Requested sample TCO by 2026-03-18.

Stakeholder quotes (paraphrased):
- Head of Infra: "We need deterministic tail behavior. If a Dedicated node misbehaves, we should fail to Hosted without customer-visible errors."
- Product Lead: "Embeddings cost is our largest variable. Show us the delta for quantized Dedicated vs Hosted before we sign."

- Legal: finalize data residency appendix; aiming to finish by 2026-03-25.
